_source: hand-written paraphrases of the public instruction templates (controlr integration-2), for the vocabulary fallback's robustness test

plug_in_charger: Put the charger into the socket.
Insert the plug of the charger into the power outlet.
make_toast: Place two bread slices in the toaster and push its lever.
hang_mugs: Hang every mug on the rack.
Put the mugs onto the mug holder.
deposit_coin: Insert the coin into the piggy bank.
Take the coin off its stand and drop it into the bank.
fasten_screws: Screw each bolt into the matching nut.
Fasten every screw onto the nut with the same colour.
insert_tubes: Put the tubes in the tube rack.
Place each test tube into the rack.
play_Xylophone: Hit every key of the xylophone with the mallet, left to right.
Use the mallet to play the xylophone.
fill_egg_holder: Put all eggs into the egg holder and close it.
Move the eggs from the basket to the egg holder.
fill_pen_holder: Put the pens in the pen holder.
Lift the pen holder and drop every pen into it.
sweep_blocks: Sweep the cubes into the dustpan using the broom.
Use the broom and the pan to clean up the blocks.
store_laptop_and_headphones: Put the headphones on their stand and store the laptop.
Close the laptop and put it in the laptop rack after hanging the headset.
play_stacking_toy: Put the stacking toy rings on the pegs.
Place every piece of the stacking toy on its peg.
store_tools_in_toolbox: Put each tool in its slot of the toolbox.
Store the hammer, pliers, wrench and tape measure in the tool box.
insert_key: Use the key: insert it into the lock and turn it.
Put the key in the keyhole and rotate it.
press_by_number: Press each red button as many times as the number card shows, then the blue one.
Push the buttons according to the cards and confirm with the blue button.
swap_blocks: Exchange the two cubes using the free mat and press the button after every move.
Swap the blocks via the empty pad, pressing the button each time.
make_kong: Once the opponent discards, declare a kong with your tiles.
Wait for the discard and expose the matching mahjong tiles.
build_tower: Stack the wooden blocks and boards into a tower.
Make a tower out of the wooden blocks and boards.
organize_table: Put the alarm clock on the drawer, the figurine on the stand, the mouse on its pad and push the keyboard into the frame.
Tidy the desk: clock on the drawer, mouse on the mouse pad, keyboard into the frame.
play_tic_tac_toe: Play a game of tic tac toe against the opponent, going first.
Fill the board with your pieces taking turns with the opponent.
match_and_pick_from_conveyor: Watch the conveyor, remember the first item, and pick its twin when it comes back.
pick_from_conveyor_by_image: Raise the basket, find the object shown in the photo on the conveyor and put it in the basket.
